items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures up to 103 degrees expected.

* WHERE...San Joaquin Valley and Sierra Foothills.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Saturday to 10 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Moderate to major risk of heat-related
illnesses for much of the population, especially those without
effective cooling or hydration.

items.areaDesc: Sonoma Coastal Range; North Bay Interior Mountains; San Francisco Bay Shoreline; East Bay Interior Valleys; Santa Cruz Mountains; Santa Clara Valley Including San Jose; Eastern Santa Clara Hills; East Bay Hills; Southern Salinas Valley/Arroyo Seco and Lake San Antonio; Santa Lucia Mountains and Los Padres National Forest; Mountains Of San Benito County And Interior Monterey County Including Pinnacles National Park
items.classification: FACT about the issued alert; hazard is conditional
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures in the middle 90s to near 103 expected. Mild
lows in the upper 60s to middle 70s in the higher elevations will
limit overnight recovery.

* WHERE...The East Bay and San Francisco Bay Shoreline, The Santa
Clara Valley and Eastern Hills, Western Sonoma County Hills, The
Santa Cruz Mountains, Interior Monterey County and the Santa Lucia
Range, Most of San Benito County and the Cholame Hills in Southeast
Monterey County, North Bay Interior Mountains, and Southern Salinas
Valley/Arroyo Seco and Lake San Antonio.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Saturday to 10 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...This level of heat affects anyone without effective
cooling and/or adequate hydration. Impacts likely in some health
systems, heat-sensitive industries and infrastructure.

items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Riverside County Mountains, San Diego County Mountains, and
San Gorgonio Pass near Banning.

* WHEN...From 6 AM to 6 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
